neighbours.label: The first word of the main clause after a fronted adverbial or subordinate clause when the comma is omitted (In addition the council has..., Before the guards could react the prisoners...)
fire: After the storm had passed the villagers returned to assess the damage.
In spite of the delay the shipment arrived in good condition.
If the weather holds we will plant the beans on Saturday.
As a result the company lost two of its largest clients.
When the whistle blew the players walked slowly off the pitch.
Without any warning the lights in the hall went out.
On the other hand the cheaper model lacks a backup camera.
Although he was tired he finished the report before midnight.
quiet: After the storm had passed, the villagers returned to assess the damage.
In spite of the delay, the shipment arrived in good condition.
If the weather holds, we will plant the beans on Saturday.
As a result, the company lost two of its largest clients.
When the whistle blew, the players walked slowly off the pitch.
Without any warning, the lights in the hall went out.
On the other hand, the cheaper model lacks a backup camera.
Although he was tired, he finished the report before midnight.

predictions: English sentences with a fronted adverbial or subordinate clause and no comma reach 0.35-0.65 at the first word of the main clause. The same sentences with the comma stay under 0.05. (The probe's French item did not fire, so the test is English only.)
short: main clause after a fronted phrase, no comma
notes: Probe: 'In addition the council has' 0.597 (peak ' has'), 'Before the guards could react the prisoners' 0.621 (peak ' the'), 'In conclusion Churchill said' 0.497 (peak ' said'), 'For more information please visit' 0.382 (peak ' please'); with commas 0.018, 0.011, 0.008, 0.038; 'has in addition approved' (not fronted) 0.121; French 'Pour rappel ce modèle' 0.068. Card: Spanish, Arabic, French, English and Russian examples all peak on the word that opens the main clause after a fronted phrase with no comma (Villegas dijo, In conclusion Stalin, In addition it, Malgré cela nous, Before Frodo could react the).
